observations: body L3: «الخاصّة» and «المعدَّلة» are printed with elongated joins (kashīda), not transcribed.
body L4: a small dot is printed below the 7 of «٩٧–٩٨»; not transcribed.
body L9: a small slanted speck is printed above the end of the line, to the right of «مسيره»; not transcribed.
body L12: a short horizontal stroke (2.0 points) is printed between «غير» and «شيء»; not transcribed.
body L14, L19: a dot is printed in the empty right part of L14, far from «رفع.», and another before «Cfr.» (L19); not transcribed.
body L16: the three digits of «٢٢٦» touch (9.0 points, three stems); the second 2 and the 6 together resemble a 3, as on p. 326.
body L17: no comma is printed between «مُعَدَّلٌ» and «١٥٩».
body L21, L24: the comma after «σφαῖρα» (L21) is printed short (1.6 by 2.3 points), like the comma after «ὄνοι» (L24).
body L22: a dot is printed below the final a of «abalhantica»; not transcribed.
body L24, L29, L30, L34, L35: «aṣ–Ṣūfī» (L24, L35) and «al–Qazwīnī» (L29, L30, L34, L35) are printed with an en dash (5.4-5.6 points); a dot is printed below the dash of «al–Qazwīnī» in L30.
body L16, L29: the sign over the m of «فَمْ» is a sukūn (2.0 by 3.1 points, the shape of the sukūn of «مُحْكَمٌ» in L16), not a damma; transcribed as printed.

body L32: the dash before «وَقْت» is printed as two short strokes almost touching (4.4 and 2.4 points), as on p. 325; a short slanted mark (2.3 by 1.9 points), smaller than a kasra, is printed below the t and ḥ of «التحويل»; not transcribed.
body L35: the hyphen of «Wüsten-» is printed as a short point.
body L34: the hamza of «الحَوَّاءُ» is cast with its damma in one sort (one small loop on its head, 3.7 by 5.2 points; the plain hamza measures about 3.9 by 3.2), as that of «أدِلَّاءُ» on p. 331.
notes_left L5: «restreindre à» is printed in roman, the French words before it in italic.
notes_right L4: a mark is printed over the n of «in»; not transcribed.
